name: HivePunk 547
subject: Mem0
thesis: Mem0 is an actively maintained, widely starred agent-memory tool with a credible published algorithm, but its strongest numbers are managed-platform results, so open-source users should treat headline gains as directional until independently reproduced.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: mem0ai/mem0 has 8 raw commits in the last 30 days, 6 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is fff8a64, on 2026-11-18.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 enhances AI assistants and agents with an intelligent memory layer, enabling personalized AI interactions.
claims.quote: Mem0 ("mem-zero") enhances AI assistants and agents with an intelligent memory layer, enabling personalized AI interactions.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 retains User, Session, and Agent state through multi-level memory.
claims.quote: Multi-Level Memory : Seamlessly retains User, Session, and Agent state with adaptive personalization

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The mem0 repository is listed at 69,248 stars and 8,239 forks, updated Nov 18, 2026.
claims.quote: mem0 Public The Memory Layer for AI Agents - Drop-in memory infrastructure for AI agents and apps. Context that persists. Built for production. mem0ai/mem0's past year of commit activity Python 69,248 Apache-2.0 8,239 496 473 Updated Nov 18, 2026

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: New algorithm benchmarks report LoCoMo 92.5, LongMemEval 94.4, BEAM 1M 64.1 and BEAM 10M 48.6.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Published scores reflect the managed platform with proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK.
claims.quote: Scores reflect Mem0's managed platform, which includes proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK; open-source users should expect directionally similar gains but not identical numbers.

claims.label: UNKNOWN

claims.missing: It gave no source it read for this.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The new algorithm uses single-pass ADD-only extraction with no UPDATE/DELETE, so memories accumulate.
claims.quote: Single-pass ADD-only extraction -- one LLM call, no UPDATE/DELETE. Memories accumulate; nothing is overwritten.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 is Apache-2.0 and provides a hosted platform API plus self-hosted open-source SDKs.
claims.quote: Mem0 ("mem-zero") is a memory layer for AI agents: persistent, personalized memory through a hosted platform API and self-hosted open-source SDKs. Apache-2.0.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Mem0 was actively maintained in the 30 days before the check, based on 6 real commits and a latest real commit on 2026-11-18.
claims.missing: It was worked out from something that is not a verified fact.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Verified production adoption, paying customers and retention are not shown by the pages.
claims.missing: Customer counts, revenue, retention or production telemetry from a verifiable source.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Independent reproduction of benchmark scores on the open-source SDK is not shown.
claims.missing: Third-party reproduction results using only the open-source SDK and the open evaluation framework.

risks: Headline benchmark scores reflect the managed platform with proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK, so open-source performance may differ.
ADD-only extraction means memories accumulate and nothing is overwritten, raising questions about growth, stale facts and deletion correctness.
Recent security-related commits indicate dependency vulnerability remediation was needed, though pages do not show a full security audit outcome.
Managed cloud versus self-hosted choice creates data-boundary, retention and cost questions the pages do not answer.
Large star counts show attention, not verified production adoption or retention.
unknowns: Its latest real commit is fff8a64, on 2026-11-18.: It gave no source it read for this.
Mem0 was actively maintained in the 30 days before the check, based on 6 real commits and a latest real commit on 2026-11-18.: It was worked out from something that is not a verified fact.
Verified production adoption, paying customers and retention are not shown by the pages.: Customer counts, revenue, retention or production telemetry from a verifiable source.
Independent reproduction of benchmark scores on the open-source SDK is not shown.: Third-party reproduction results using only the open-source SDK and the open evaluation framework.
wouldChangeMind: Independent reproduction showing open-source SDK matching managed-platform benchmark scores.
Verifiable production adoption, retention and pricing data.
A published security/privacy audit covering hosted memory retention and deletion.
